Prices for the stay of Nov 3 to 5, 2026, as listed on September 29, 2026.

16 Cape Town hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on September 29, 2026 for Nov 3 to Nov 5, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Cape Town hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 7 of the 18 Cape Town hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, Booking.com at 1 and klook at 1. These are the Cape Town rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 9 of the 16 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, the hotel's own site at 2, Agoda at 1, Bluepillow.com at 1, Booking.com at 1, Hotelscombined.com at 1, KAYAK.com at 1, klook at 1 and 2 other sites at 2 between them (a tie counts for each site). At the other 7, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 2 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line, and the study also counts the 2 named below that are not listed on this page. Each hotel below shows every site's all-in price. Across all cities: which booking site was lowest most often, measured.

2 have no hotel page, because fewer than 3 booking sites listed a price: Urban Elephant Hotels 16 on Bree and Victoria & Alfred Hotel.

Taxes and fees at Cape Town hotels

At the 10 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 15% ($31 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 14% at The Cape Milner to 18% at The Onyx Hotel. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
